correctness.rationale: The contradiction is exact. In Martín Duro's Type-II case the two one-dimensional modules fix each three-dimensional simple, so the relevant grouplike stabilizer has order two. For an irreducible character of a semisimple Hopf algebra, the standard Nichols-Zoeller consequence gives that the stabilizer order divides the square of the character degree. Hence two would have to divide nine. Dualizing handles a right-versus-left tensor convention without changing the contradiction. The source classification then removes its sole stated exception below dimension 32.
